programme.desc: This programme focuses on national treasures and archaeology.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laikas mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yis husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the Happy Spinsters Club set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called Kung Fu Stuntmen. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Lis daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kongs brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Jailed for accidental manslaughter, martial arts master Har Hao Mo discovers a killer targeting kung fu masters across Hong Kong. Determined to stop the murders, he helps police track down Fung Yu Sau, a ruthless fighter obsessed with proving his supremacy. As the killings continue, the two martial artists are drawn toward a deadly showdown.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Mins friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Mins death.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tais father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Final Justice 1988
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Lets Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the schools stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xins ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival.

When Lula and Luis want a clubhouse for the Squasher Fan Club, TZG secretly help fix up the shed in Luis backyard.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - It Takes a Zenko What a Racket
programme.desc: When various townsfolk report having lost soft belongings, TZG secretly investigates to discover thieving pigeon Yolanda had been building a nest for baby gophers. When Ians lucky badminton racket goes missing, TZG secretly finds and returns it in time for a rematch against his toughest opponent.

programme.title: Caspers Scare School S1 - 2500 Candles For Ra Its A Mad Mad Mad Underworld
programme.desc: 2500 Candles for Ra Upset that no one remembered his birthday, Ra goes to hang out with the mummies at the Deedstown museum. Its a Mad, Mad, Mad Underworld When Casper finds Cappys old treasure map, he promises to help the pirate find his lost fortune.

programme.title: Caspers Scare School S1 - Curse Of The Sandwich A Real Little Monster
programme.desc: Curse of the Sandwich After Ra accidentally bites into Thatchs sandwich, he becomes convinced that hes turning into a vampire. Real Little Monster When Norman the bully comes after Jimmy, Casper helps his human friend hide in the one place he knows Norman wont lookScare School.

programme.title: Gabbys Dollhouse S2 - Fluffy Flufferton
programme.desc: Feline popstar sensation Fluffy Flufferton is performing a concert at the Dollhouse Hotel, and Gabby unboxes tickets to see her! Gabby meets Fluffy and discovers that shes afraid to try new things because she doesnt want to make mistakeswhy mess with perfection? But with the help of the Gabby Cats, Fluffy learns how to fail fantastically and be the most fluff-tastic version of herself. For our

programme.title: Gabbys Dollhouse S2 - Cakeys Cupcake Cousins
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a tin full of Cakey-like cupcake kitties, she realizes... Cakeys Cousins are coming to visit! Cakey welcomes his Cousins to the dollhouse and leads them through a fun-filled itinerary of activities, but quickly realizes his cousins have an agenda of their own. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Pillow Cat sings a song!

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Gratitude
programme.desc: When Phoebes Gratitude Day card flies away before she can give it to Marcus, the Dews try to help her recreate it - perfectly. But they learn that you dont have to be perfect to show your gratitude for someone. When Athena finds herself a little short-handed at the Fairhaven Summer Fair, her cousin, Reed, comes to help only to give Athena more problems to fix.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Dew Glue Dew Believer
programme.desc: When Harpers ceramic dragon is smashed, the Dews must find all the pieces. But when a piece ends up missing, the Dews work together to create a new piece, hoping no one will notice. Dylan goes to great lengths to invite his Dew Drop to his soccer game but, in the process, learns that sometimes believing in something is more powerful than seeing something.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Best Friends Day The White Whale
programme.desc: Pixie loves to ride the clouds, but she cant understand why Kelp doesnt love it, too. If they dont agree on this, does that mean theyre not best friends anymore? Kelp helps Ollie fulfill his dream of watching the white whale migration.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Shark and Pilot Fish Theo
programme.desc: When shark and pilot fish are separated its up to Kelp, Scallop, Cruz, and Waverly to help them find each other again. Scallops friend Theo finally comes clean on why hes always rushing off.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Bad Moon Rising
programme.desc: After a strange creature bites Tuffnut, he believes hell turn into a legendary Lycanwing dragon when the moon is full unless his friends can save him

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Snoutlout Gets The Axe
programme.desc: When Snotlout and Astrid must fly a ceremonial battle axe to a family wedding, they must work together when an Armorwing dragon derails their plan

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - The Zippleback Experience
programme.desc: After heroes Hiccup and Toothless save Barf and Belchs life, the grateful Zippleback tries to repay its life debt and abandons riders Ruff and Tuff

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Snow Way Out
programme.desc: Determined to create a key to the Dragon Eye, Ryker heads to Glacier Island to find the dangerous Snow Wraith being protected by the Dragon Riders

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Edge Of Disaster Pt 1
programme.desc: When Ruffnut is captured by Dragon Hunters, its up to Astrid and Tuffnut to defend Dragons Edge from the invading Dragon Hunter army Dragons Edge from the invading Dragon Hunter army

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Edge Of Disaster Pt 2
programme.desc: Unaware of the war on Dragons Edge, Hiccup, Snotlout and Johann discover an island full of dragons that have been wounded by the Dragon Hunters

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Shock And Awe
programme.desc: When a new dragon is found in Edge Cove, the Dragon Riders must help the Sea Shocker escape a group of hungry Scauldrons

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - A Time To Skrill
programme.desc: When the Skrill returns with a vendetta against Hiccup and Toothless, the Dragon Riders must choose a new course of action to stop the vicious dragon

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Mad Scientist
programme.desc: The Mad Scientist turns out to be an ally called Akna, who has a history with Blades brother Alfie. And Blade learns another truth about her brother and his mission. And in the course of a skirmish with Klaus and Veruca, the weapons change hands again.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Apok-ta-pokalypse Now Part 1
programme.desc: As the Dragon Knights prepare to battle for the weapons and control of Tikal, Mastodon attempts to teach Po how to access storm powers to use in the fight. Blade comes face to face with Klaus and Veruca.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Apok-ta-pokalypse Now Part 2
programme.desc: The team heads into a final confrontation for the weapons that not only threatens Tikal, but their lives. And Po must share hero duties with Mastodon.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Ga Ba Goo Ba Ga The Babblist
programme.desc: Theres a new babblist in town- someone who claims to understand baby talk. Boss Baby spots this fraud right awayand must debunk his tactics before he scams the playgroup parents. MeanwhileTim tries to sell magazines with Boss Babys help.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - The Coo Chi Coup
programme.desc: Boss Baby loves awards- and the Golden Rattle trophy is no exception. When presented with the chance to win an award at a company retreathe must choose between his pride and his team.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Lights, Camera, Org Chart!
programme.desc: Boss Baby creates an org chart to cement his leadership as the Boss of the playgroup babies. However when Bubbeezee photographer Travis Le Duque chooses anyone but Boss for his coverspreadthe status quo is upended! Tim continues to fail his class assignment: a model solar system

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Night Of The Hunters Pt 2
programme.desc: As Hiccup and Snotlout race to rescue the others from Ryker and the Dragon Hunters, they dont realize Dagur and Heather are working with the enemy

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Bad Moon Rising
programme.desc: After a strange creature bites Tuffnut, he believes hell turn into a legendary Lycanwing dragon when the moon is full unless his friends can save him

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Snoutlout Gets The Axe
programme.desc: When Snotlout and Astrid must fly a ceremonial battle axe to a family wedding, they must work together when an Armorwing dragon derails their plan

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Maces And Talons Pt 1
programme.desc: When they learn the Dragon Hunters are tracking the Flightmare, Hiccup and Astrid race to stop them after Heather spills secrets from Viggo Grimborn

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Maces And Talons Pt 2
programme.desc: After Heather and the Flightmare have been captured by Viggo and the Dragon Hunters, Hiccup must develop a plan to outwit this dangerous new enemy

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Enemy Of My Enemy
programme.desc: After Hiccup is shot down on a remote island while searching for Viggo and the Dragon Hunters, he questions Dagurs intentions to rescue him.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Crash Course
programme.desc: When a dangerous subterranean Cavern Crasher dragon invades the Fireworm Queens underground nest, she approaches the Riders on Dragons Edge for help.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Follow The Leader
programme.desc: When Fishlegs discovers a hidden civilization of Albino Night Terrors beneath Dragons Edge, he must craft an escape plan after they attack the Riders.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Turn And Burn
programme.desc: Stoick, Hiccup and Snotlout search for Spitelout when he goes missing, and ultimately find him on a distant island battling a fiery Singetail dragon.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Buffalord Soldier
programme.desc: Astrid comes down with the Odins Revenge flu and the Riders must search for the cure by finding a nearly extinct Buffalord dragon before Viggo does.

programme.desc: 喬天生（陳展鵬飾）和羅威信（蕭正楠飾）是同母異父的親兄弟，因為命運令他們不單分開在香港和澳門兩地，更令他們嘗盡劇變歷史中的兩極衝突 母親周玉梅（李司棋飾）帶著小兒子威信在澳門當黑市居民，威信憑著努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮飾）與龍飛（阮兆祥飾）的相助，歷盡艱辛，克服挑戰，最終踏上成功之路獨自在港自食其力的天生卻改走捷徑，聯結黑道古惑仔姜勇（張繼聰飾），與富家女發生關係，令女友卓靜（鍾嘉欣飾）傷心欲絕，最終落得人財兩空 本是唇齒相依的手足情，經歷時代巨輪的洗禮，前境變幻莫測，二人愈走愈遠，但一個信念深植在他們相連的血脈裡，縱然考驗再苦再難，終在一條又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 陪著你走 Every Step You Take
programme.desc: 雜誌攝影師宋天從胡杏兒因一場意外，失去了雙親也失去了光明，天性愛美和煲電視劇的天從卻未有自暴自棄，男朋友杜正恆張穎康和導盲犬的陪伴令她漸漸重拾自信，她的座右銘更是一句廣告標題愛是無所不能，成為她從傷痛中走出來的力量，誰料這個廣告的創作人甘言重陳豪如今就住在她的隔鄰因沉溺工作令言重失去所有朋友和同事，連徒弟阮婉姚子羚也決定辭職，言重有點迷失，決定放一個悠長假期，重回舊居生活，尋回昔日好朋友余加勁麥長青重回舊地，不單令言重重新出發，更讓他重新認識自己，男友移情別戀令天從再度陷入低潮，幸有言重在旁成為守護天使，二人風馬牛不相及的性格竟擦出了愛火花，以為看見的卻發現盲點，本是瞎眼的卻得見光明.

programme.title: 使徒行者3 Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: 薛家強林峯飾完成三年臥底任務後，回港開設沐足店，繼續收集情報刑事情報科總督察章紀孜黃智雯飾懷疑卓凱苗僑偉飾出獄後投入黑道，對他進行全面監視家強與卓凱捲入器官販賣案，聯同女臥底竇亞希蔡思貝飾及保安局調查官韋作榮馬國明飾，合力搗破涉案集團保安局及後新設安全情報機構，並邀得徐天堂袁偉豪飾加入，接管刑事情報科的工作覃歡喜許紹雄飾逃過一死後，暗中調查某社團的秘密神秘社團原來由長興已故龍頭魏德信的弟弟魏德禮創立，他還設下佈局，對家強卓凱等展開報復.

programme.title: 刀下留人 Executioner, The
programme.desc: 殺人無數的劊子手葉常綠黃德斌為保護恩公的媳婦阮素心姚子羚順利產子，將素心安頓在京城享負盛名的穩婆花蕊紅邵美琪家中，因而遇上離奇命案，常綠竟以其鬼頭刀救活了一條小生命，誰料這名來歷不明的男嬰令常綠和蕊紅無故捲入朝廷的政治漩渦，一冷一熱的配搭化解了一次又一次的危機，兩人在患難中漸生情愫；另邊廂，一對同在妓院長大的小情侶赤知秋楊明和祝小滿龔嘉欣來到蕊紅家，苦苦哀求常綠收知秋為劊子手的學徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脫受刑，常綠遲疑不決，一名神秘的彩戲師司馬丑陳山聰出現，令各人關係陷入錯綜複雜，男嬰身分之謎更因而被逐步揭開，但同時敲起了死神的喪鐘.

programme.title: 荷里活有個大老千 I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: 千門八將的龍四鄭則仕飾被華探長文雄湯鎮業飾與大師兄龐峰秦沛飾設局陷害入獄，女友百合張慧儀飾更被文雄搶去五年後，龍四成為地位崇高的製片，有舒奇蔡瀚億飾麥基吳業坤飾兩位得力助手，還有一個剛相認的女兒小雨王子涵飾師弟唐偉黃栢文飾被殺，龍四鎖定其徒弟阿朗馬志威飾所為，二人賭枱上對決小雨向舞蹈老師百合傾訴暗戀新晉導演賀加俊何浩文飾，意外令百合龍四重逢百合偷去文雄的黑金帳簿準備私奔，文雄一怒下趕絕二人龍四押送入獄途中被神秘人劫走，他們正策劃一個捕獸籠，誓把隻手遮天的文雄引入內.

programme.title: 荷里活有個大老千 I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: 千門八將的龍四鄭則仕飾被華探長文雄湯鎮業飾與大師兄龐峰秦沛飾設局陷害入獄，女友百合張慧儀飾更被文雄搶去五年後，龍四成為地位崇高的製片，有舒奇蔡瀚億飾麥基吳業坤飾兩位得力助手，還有一個剛相認的女兒小雨王子涵飾師弟唐偉黃栢文飾被殺，龍四鎖定其徒弟阿朗馬志威飾所為，二人賭枱上對決小雨向舞蹈老師百合傾訴暗戀新晉導演賀加俊何浩文飾，意外令百合龍四重逢百合偷去文雄的黑金帳簿準備私奔，文雄一怒下趕絕二人龍四押送入獄途中被神秘人劫走，他們正策劃一個捕獸籠，誓把隻手遮天的文雄引入內.

programme.title: 食為奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天寶王祖藍自小吃盡珍饈百味，各種美食經他一嚐便知龍與鳳，但遭逢家道中落被迫與家僕李衛胡諾言流落街頭，以賣飽糊口，因美食令他結識了賣藝女子紀慕雪萬綺雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女廚神米小魚何雁詩等人，更因緣際會遇上微服出遊的四皇子胤禛黃智賢，二人氣味相投，被引進到宮內的御膳房當御廚，天寶遇上宿敵蔡鶴亭林盛斌，掀起連場龍爭虎鬥；但天寶萬料不到自己竟捲入由八皇子胤禩張繼聰策動的奪嫡之爭中，在劣勢下天寶成了胤禛的福將，連番替他反敗為勝，但一段意外的婚約卻令天寶由一人之下頓貶為喪家狗.

programme.title: 愛情食物鏈 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 從事食品供應的魯佳芳阮小儀樣子平凡，身材矮小，年過三十仍欠缺戀愛經驗，因一次苦瓜事件，幫助餐飲業才俊劉柏業陳智燊渡過難關，令這位高富帥欣賞到佳芳的內在美，並與她漸生情愫，佳芳的鄰居兼好友高貴芬高海寧對此無法釋懷，賣魚出身的貴芬樣貌身材皆屬女神級數，千方百計也未能令柏業過電，卻召來台灣擔仔麵繼承者洪鱻金剛的青睞，洪鱻為親近貴芬不惜自貶身價與佳芳她們同住劏房，貴芬得不到柏業唯有轉戰二叔劉利高鄭子誠，但後來柏業承受不了外界對女友佳芳的負評，二人關係亮起紅燈；當愛情再不是飲水飽，美醜優劣再無標準，男女同時成了獵人與獵物，血肉橫飛的戀愛激戰即將一發不可收拾.

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 Sinister Beings 2
programme.desc: O記幹探許浚森陳展鵬飾沈韋力黃智賢飾奉命調查跨國罪案期間，得悉殺虎案幕後黑手魏子樂張頴康飾落網前，曾將神秘訊息發送至暗網，並匯出巨額加密貨幣不久有神秘人策動恐襲，浚森與韋力縱於天才教授唐冠峰方力申飾協助下破案，卻驚覺子樂背後藏着更大陰謀！他們要竭力阻止子樂的同時，也遇到龍頭棍風暴空屋藏白骨重犯越獄等奇案，能否一一掃除險阻？工作上面對的危機升級，感情亦遇挑戰，浚森望跟前女友馬穎思林夏薇飾復合，但困難重重令二人關係出現變數.

programme.title: 大醬園 Dripping Sauce, The
programme.desc: 萬冠園是佛山醬油業百年老字號，大當家萬啟山吳岱融飾與夫人席德容龔慈恩飾堅持傳男不傳女，傳內不傳外的宗旨，可是一宗毒醬油事故，使他不得不答應讓夏小滿朱晨麗飾及葉細么龔嘉欣飾兩女子加入，與其子萬卓楓何廣沛飾成為同期學徒三人與醬園小師傅華歌吳業坤飾建立了複雜的四角關係，又間接揭發了萬家多個秘密，加上卓楓突然被擄走，人心惶惶醬園內，啟山幾個弟弟啟石鄭子誠飾啟川陳嘉輝飾及啟江徐榮飾醞釀分家，醬園外，專員高兆榮袁文傑飾也密謀奪取醬園財產，萬冠園百年基業隨時毀於一旦！.

programme.desc: 高天寶王祖藍自小吃盡珍饈百味，各種美食經他一嚐便知龍與鳳，但遭逢家道中落被迫與家僕李衛胡諾言流落街頭，以賣飽糊口，因美食令他結識了賣藝女子紀慕雪萬綺雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女廚神米小魚何雁詩等人，更因緣際會遇上微服出遊的四皇子胤禛黃智賢，二人氣味相投，被引進到宮內的御膳房當御廚，天寶遇上宿敵蔡鶴亭林盛斌，掀起連場龍爭虎鬥；但天寶萬料不到自己竟捲入由八皇子胤禩張繼聰策動的奪嫡之爭中，在劣勢下天寶成了胤禛的福將，連番替他反敗為勝，但一段意外的婚約卻令天寶由一人之下頓貶為喪家狗.

programme.title: 愛情食物鏈 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 從事食品供應的魯佳芳阮小儀樣子平凡，身材矮小，年過三十仍欠缺戀愛經驗，因一次苦瓜事件，幫助餐飲業才俊劉柏業陳智燊渡過難關，令這位高富帥欣賞到佳芳的內在美，並與她漸生情愫，佳芳的鄰居兼好友高貴芬高海寧對此無法釋懷，賣魚出身的貴芬樣貌身材皆屬女神級數，千方百計也未能令柏業過電，卻召來台灣擔仔麵繼承者洪鱻金剛的青睞，洪鱻為親近貴芬不惜自貶身價與佳芳她們同住劏房，貴芬得不到柏業唯有轉戰二叔劉利高鄭子誠，但後來柏業承受不了外界對女友佳芳的負評，二人關係亮起紅燈；當愛情再不是飲水飽，美醜優劣再無標準，男女同時成了獵人與獵物，血肉橫飛的戀愛激戰即將一發不可收拾.

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 Sinister Beings 2
programme.desc: O記幹探許浚森陳展鵬飾沈韋力黃智賢飾奉命調查跨國罪案期間，得悉殺虎案幕後黑手魏子樂張頴康飾落網前，曾將神秘訊息發送至暗網，並匯出巨額加密貨幣不久有神秘人策動恐襲，浚森與韋力縱於天才教授唐冠峰方力申飾協助下破案，卻驚覺子樂背後藏着更大陰謀！他們要竭力阻止子樂的同時，也遇到龍頭棍風暴空屋藏白骨重犯越獄等奇案，能否一一掃除險阻？工作上面對的危機升級，感情亦遇挑戰，浚森望跟前女友馬穎思林夏薇飾復合，但困難重重令二人關係出現變數.

programme.title: Pink Smile
programme.desc: Iman yang balik dari luar negara berusaha mencari Luna, dia berminat dengan gadis tersebut semenjak dari bangku sekolah lagi. Namun Luna menyembunyikan diri, Fazrin memberitahu Iman bahawa Luna telah ke Korea. Areeq pula mula rindukan Luna selepas 2 minggu tidak berjumpa, Luna merajuk selepas ternampak Areeq bersama dengan Rysa. Sebenarnya Luna juga rindunya Areeq tetapi cuba menyembunyikan perasaannya. Mereka akhirnya terjumpa secara kebetulan, Areeq menyatakan perasaan rindunya kepada Luna. Tiba-tiba muncul Iman di lokasi membuat Luna terkesima.

programme.title: Pink Smile
programme.desc: Luna melarikan diri kerana tidak mahu berjumpa dengan Iman. Manakala Iman berjumpa dengan Areeq diterima bekerja di cafe tersebut. Areeq pula sengaja menghantar donut pink kegemaran Luna selepas gadis tersebut merajuk dan tidak mahu berkawan dengannya lagi. Di akhir episod, Luna terkejut apabila diberitahu terdapat donut baru Maidula Donut di Duncan Cafe. Hanya Iman sahaja yang pandai membuat donut tersebut.

programme.title: Pink Smile
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Areeq meminta Iman tidak lagi membuat Mainulla Donut, hanya Pink Donut sahaja dibenarkan. Hj. Di Duncan Cafe, Melati tidak gembira dengan Rysa. Iman berbaik-baik dengan Melati, dia mulai sukakannya.

programme.title: Pink Smile
programme.desc: Mengisahkan keluarga Luna masih di kampung Hj. Mahadi, Luna jatuh pengsan selepas melewati rumah berhantu selepas balik dari Solat Tarawikh. Perhubungan keduanya semakin mesra. Namun usaha yang dilakukan oleh Areqq masih tidak dapat membuka hari Luna, Rysa mencadangkan supaya Areeq melupakannya sahaja Luna. Rysa dan Faiz tidak serasi. Pada yang sama, Luna baru mengetahui Areeq ialah pelukis komik terkenal. Iman akhirnya terjumpa Luna bersama Areeq.

programme.title: Pink Smile
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Melati cemburu melihat perhubungan Areeq dengan Luna. Satu hari, Luna menutup butiknya lebih awal kerana membuat temujanji dengan Areeq, ini menyebabkan dia dimarahi oleh ibunya. Areeq pula terlupa pergi untuk temujanji tersebut. programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran Hantu-Hantu Dunia untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.title: Gourmet Express ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. (香港汇集全球菜,其独特的菜和精致的菜吸引了富有挑的爱好者! 食物主持人和主持人如Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong,Jessica Liu,Gillian Ng跟上最新的食物新闻和交易,深入了解味道背后的故事. 收集了各种平台的流行餐厅的第一手信息,主持人亲自排列并品尝食物,提供了真实的评论.即使没有餐饮选择的餐厅也很受欢迎.)

programme.title: Want To De-stress (想摆脱压力)
programme.desc: Many urban dwellers are constantly striving for a living and a career, leaving no time for relaxation. The accumulated stress can quickly trigger health problems. This program invites professionals from various fields, such as aromatherapists, music therapists, color therapists, nutritionists, and psychologists, to use accessible methods, including case studies and fun quizzes, to bring out the harmony and balance of the five senses, helping viewers instantly release stress. Celebrities will also be invited to have candid conversations with the host, sharing their effective methods for coping with the heavy pressures of life and work. The program also includes many interesting stress-reduction tips to deepen viewers understanding of the importance of stress reduction for health. (许多城市居民都在为生活和职业生涯而努力,没有时间放松,积累的压力会迅速引发健康问题。这个计划邀请各个领域的专业人员,如芳香疗法师、音乐治疗师、彩色治疗师、营养学家和心理学家,使用无障碍的方法,包括案例研究和有趣的测验,以体现五感的和谐与平衡,帮助观众立即释放压力。这个计划还将邀请名人与东道方进行坦率的对话,分享他们应对生活和工作沉重压力的有效方法。这个计划还包括许多有趣的减压提示,以加深观众对减压对健康的重要性的理解。)

programme.title: Try It? Really? Sr.2 ((試真D Sr.2))
programme.desc: Elena Kong once again leads the team, joining forces with Cheung Chun-long, Chu Man-han, Ng Yip-kwan, and Tseng Zhan-wang to form the Try It Out Team, returning with acclaim after the hit first season and enthusiastic praise from netizens. This new in-depth exploration of Taiwan will see the team continue their relaxed, authentic, and down-to-earth style, guiding viewers deep into the islands heart. The team travels to Kaohsiung, Tainan, and Taipei, continuing the shows spirit by uncovering controversial shops with polarized online reviews, as well as hidden gems and little-known experiences tucked away in the citys corners. The team is committed to presenting the most genuine on-site feedback, aiming to create a practical travel guide to Taiwan that avoids pitfalls for viewers. (Elena Kong再次领导团队,与张春龙、楚曼汉、吴宜宽和郑俊旺联合组建了Triing It Out团队,在第一季打完后以赞美和网友的热情赞美回来。 这次对台湾的新的深入探索将看到团队继续其放松、真实和自下而上的方式,引导观众深入岛屿心脏。 团队前往高盛、太南和台北,通过通过对极化的在线评论以及隐藏的宝石和鲜为人知的经验揭开有争议的商店,继续展示其精神。 团队致力于展示最真实的现场反馈,旨在创建实用的台湾旅游指南,避免观众陷入陷阱。)

programme.title: A Date with Goddess Sr.2 ((女神配对计划 Sr.2))
programme.desc: The dating reality show A Date with Goddess is back with a bang, and the second seasons love battlefield is all upgraded! Golden Matchmaker Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the heart-fluttering light and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the Peanut Team, providing live coverage of the goddesses dates. (与女神交配的真人秀《与女神的约会》又回到了一起,第二季的爱情战场也都升级了!金媒人鲍勃·拉姆正在从世界各地招募男人来配对女神何培霞、郭培勉、陈若熙、于克采诚和元甲曼。勇敢的追求者面临着挑战,比如,用他们自己的独特策略来赢得女神。一对一的亲密游戏点燃了燃心的兴奋情绪,一个隐藏的女神加入了这场争斗,进一步加大了等待的火花,勇敢的求婚者们努力到达终点并捕捉女神的心!此外,上个季节的五个女神,以及名人宾,将轮流成为Peanut小组,提供女神约会的现场报道。)

programme.title: J Music 2026 (音乐2026年)

The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry. (J音乐致力于创建高质量的音乐平台,为歌手提供展示其音乐天赋的机会,同时让音乐迷能够更深入地了解其音乐故事。这个节目邀请流行歌手作为嘉宾,亲自选择其最喜欢的新旧作品,现场演出,并分享其最喜欢的曲目。音乐场面的新面孔也将出现,通过互动交流展示其音乐潜力。此外,每集都密切关注《玉实金图》的最新发展,包括音乐视频和与各种歌手、作曲家和制作者的访谈,他们讨论他们的工作以及音乐行业内的人与活动。)

programme.title: Star Weekly ((一周星星))
programme.desc: The talk show Star Weekly invites celebrities and industry leaders each episode, along with entertainment anchors such as Au Wing-Kuen, Hsu Wen-Hsuan, and Wang Chen-Chuan, to share their recent work plans and discuss special topics related to movies, television, and concerts, especially people and events that netizens and friends in the industry are concerned about and discussing! With so much surrounding information, the show features a special Fact Check segment, where guests personally respond to various rumors, allowing the parties involved to clarify the truth! (脱口秀节目《星周刊》邀请名人和产业领袖及娱乐主持人, 如Au Wing- Quen、Hsu Wen-Husu、王朝川等, 分享他们最近的工作计划, 讨论有关电影、电视、音乐会等特别议题, 特别是网民及产业朋友关心及讨论的人士及活动! 节目内容多,)

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in Food News Report, highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information. (香港是全球烹饪的熔炉。 食物锚和东道主如黄卡梅尼、 黄卡门、 吴嘉明、 吴吉良等,不断了解最新的烹饪趋势,收集各平台上顶级餐厅的信息,主播亲自抽样食物,提供诚实的检讨,发现不同区藏有的宝石,邀请长期外雇人员访问他们最喜爱的家乡菜园知名厨师和食品批评者,也引导他们走上道路,提供专家建议。 节目特别选取了《食品新闻报告》中热门的餐厅,突出他们的签名盘子,提供快速交易,确保观众了解最美味、最廉价的餐饮信息。)

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show Sr.5 ((阿爷厨房 Sr.5))
programme.desc: Li Jiading Master Ding, the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up Master Dings Kitchen, partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how! (李建丁师,坚强的老师丁,无疑是武术的士,但他厨艺技巧也令人印象深刻!丁师与精明的食品熟练者坦尤宁合作建立了士丁厨房.每集都带着观众去寻找他们最喜欢的食材,丁师亲自做各种特色的菜,和甜点,提供怀旧的堪敦式美食!如何以负担得起的价格做真实的传统烤?如何控制鱼时的热量和时间?秋冬,许多人喜欢香水米,特别是脆的米皮.但你有没有见过士丁的米米两侧都显示了米米的米技巧吗?看看看!)

programme.desc: Liza Wang, Sammy Leung, William So, and Dickson Yu have teamed up to create a game show, inviting members of the entertainment family and guests to participate in a Werewolf Palace Edition game, revealing their foolish and clever sides. (香港生活充满活力和多样性,香港生活,香港愉悦呈现了复杂和优雅的生活方式和实在的,高质量的体验.该节目结合了各种主题,探索了每个集中的不同领域,并邀请了来自不同行业的精英分享成功的秘密.)

programme.title: Hands Up 2026 ((举起手来! 2026))
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge. programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue ((过街英雄))
programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing Sammy has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan Priscilla Wong, causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai KK Cheung, Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam. Gold digger Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngais real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan. (柳亮在一次交通事故中不幸失去了左耳,在接受移植手术后,他获得了神秘的老鼠权。良星不断制造假消息以为自己谋利。他与正直的女警察宋海燕王普西利亚(Sung Hoi-yan Pricilla Wong)发生冲突,导致他们两人失业。在她叔叔Ming Kwan-ngai KK KK 张的支持下,贺燕成为私人调查员。梁星被迫帮助慧妍探查她的调查活动,因为他利用神秘的力量去探明Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam女神。金发的Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong作为富有的家族继承人,Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau 和她成为了敌人,受到残酷的骚扰。Mi-fun-fun 原谅徐伟,并主动提出帮助他陷入困境。梁星越来越傲慢,因为他用自己的权力来解决案子。与此同时,Hoi-yyan 突然地发现我本人的心力和心力。)

programme.title: News Treasury 2026 ((新闻掏宝 2026))
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences. (据说,今天的新闻是明天的历史.每天有这么多新闻,每个人都很难收录一切,更不用说回顾历史.历史是一个宝藏,如果我们忽视或低估它,我们可能会错过它的财富. 新节目新闻宝藏猎引导观众从这个库中发现新闻宝石.除了特色,直播和过去的系列报道外,该节目还提供了前所未见的宝贵的镜像.观众将有机会重览诸如布鲁斯·李斯银行抢劫,四王妃团审判,香港的访问,出租车罢工,签署中英联合宣言,与玛格丽特·撒切尔的独家采访,越南难民,州长帕特登的死亡,中国航天机场的抵达,中国航天机场的报道)

programme.title: Cantopop At 50 ((中文))
programme.desc: Throughout the years, countless hit songs have emerged in both Chinese and international music scenes. Regardless of the era, every work has its own devoted fans. Cantopop At 50 invites original singers or accomplished vocalists to reinterpret these once-popular classics that transcend generations, delivering high-quality musical enjoyment to music lovers. In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience. (多年来,中国和国际音乐场景中都出现了无数出人意料的歌曲。 不论时代如何,每部作品都有自己的忠实粉丝。 50岁时,Cantopopo请原创歌手或有成就的唱家们重新解释这些超越世代的一度流行的经典,向音乐爱好者提供高质量的音乐娱乐。 除了在音乐产业中以有影响力的资深艺术家为主角外,这个节目还欢迎许多长期没有公开出现的歌手,给观众带来多重惊喜。)

programme.title: Woo Fung Concert 2026
programme.desc: Veteran Hong Kong entertainer Woo Fung celebrates his remarkable seven-decade career with a spectacular concert at the Hong Kong Coliseum. At 94, he performs classic songs alongside star guests including Andy Lau, Jacky Cheung and Nick Cheung. Filled with music, laughter and touching memories, the concert also marks his Guinness World Record as the oldest Chinese artist to hold a solo concert.

programme.title: J Music 2026 (音乐2026年)
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry. (J音乐致力于创建高质量的音乐平台,为歌手提供展示其音乐天赋的机会,同时让音乐迷能够更深入地了解其音乐故事。这个节目邀请流行歌手作为嘉宾,亲自选择其最喜欢的新旧作品,现场演出,并分享其最喜欢的曲目。音乐场面的新面孔也将出现,通过互动交流展示其音乐潜力。此外,每集都密切关注《玉实金图》的最新发展,包括音乐视频和与各种歌手、作曲家和制作者的访谈,他们讨论他们的工作以及音乐行业内的人与活动。)

programme.title: Vital Lifeline ((最强生命线))
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health. (城市居民往往经历着繁忙的生活和高度压力,这使他们更容易受到健康问题的影响。最强的生命线帮助你解开健康的秘密。首先,该方案在常见的城市疼痛问题上有四大系列,包括头痛、肩部和颈部疼痛、背部疼痛和联合疼痛。每集都邀请医疗专家解释这些病症的原因,以及物理治疗师和锻炼专家进行适当的锻炼。随着东西方医学结合的趋势日益增长,甚至美国游泳冠军迈克尔·菲尔普斯也使用杯式疗法来缓解疼痛。因此,每集都包括传统的中国医学诊断,辅之以针线、杯子和Sanfu草药补丁疗法等疗法,这些疗法在最热的夏季特别合适。此外,中国医药从业人员分享了营养汤的食谱,所有这些都有助于调节和改善你的健康。)

programme.title: Try It? Really? Sr.2 ((試真D Sr.2))
programme.desc: Elena Kong once again leads the team, joining forces with Cheung Chun-long, Chu Man-han, Ng Yip-kwan, and Tseng Zhan-wang to form the Try It Out Team, returning with acclaim after the hit first season and enthusiastic praise from netizens. This new in-depth exploration of Taiwan will see the team continue their relaxed, authentic, and down-to-earth style, guiding viewers deep into the islands heart. The team travels to Kaohsiung, Tainan, and Taipei, continuing the shows spirit by uncovering controversial shops with polarized online reviews, as well as hidden gems and little-known experiences tucked away in the citys corners. The team is committed to presenting the most genuine on-site feedback, aiming to create a practical travel guide to Taiwan that avoids pitfalls for viewers. (Elena Kong再次领导团队,与张春龙、楚曼汉、吴宜宽和郑俊旺联合组建了Triing It Out团队,在第一季打完后以赞美和网友的热情赞美回来。 这次对台湾的新的深入探索将看到团队继续其放松、真实和自下而上的方式,引导观众深入岛屿心脏。 团队前往高盛、太南和台北,通过通过对极化的在线评论以及隐藏的宝石和鲜为人知的经验揭开有争议的商店,继续展示其精神。 团队致力于展示最真实的现场反馈,旨在创建实用的台湾旅游指南,避免观众陷入陷阱。)

programme.title: A Date with Goddess Sr.2 ((女神配对计划 Sr.2))
programme.desc: The dating reality show A Date with Goddess is back with a bang, and the second seasons love battlefield is all upgraded! Golden Matchmaker Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. programme.title: Wo Jiao Zhang Si De
programme.desc: Set during the Chinese Communist Revolution, this historical drama follows the life of Zhang Side, a humble peasant from Sichuan who joined the Red Army. Rather than portraying him as an oversized hero, the series focuses on his quiet work ethic and selflessnessfrom surviving the Long March to serving as a guard in Yanan. In 1944, Zhang tragically dies when a charcoal kiln collapses, sacrificing his life to save a fellow soldier and leaving behind an enduring legacy of selfless service

Desperate for a comeback, they audition for a new radio station searching for elderly female hosts. Disguising themselves as old ladies, the pair unexpectedly land the job and spark a series of hilarious misadventures. (从前的DJ KK和Ah Luke电台曾经非常受欢迎,但他们的不良态度和以极端为中心的行为使他们被解雇了。 迫不及待地回访,他们为寻找老年女性主机的新电台试镜。 假扮自己是老太太,这对夫妇出乎意料地找到了工作,引发了一系列可笑的冒险。)

programme.title: Relentless Fury ((赴汤蹈火))
programme.desc: Captain Lin Lang and his elite mercenary team are tasked with escorting a mysterious woman safely home. Bearing the highest bounty in dark web history, she draws assassins from across the globe. Among them is the notorious fugitive Ray. Now, Lin and his team must survive a deadly fight to complete their mission. (Lin Lang上尉和他的精英雇佣兵团队负责护送一个神秘女人安全回家。她拥有黑暗网络史上最高的赏金,从全球各地画出刺客。其中有臭名昭著的逃犯Ray。现在,Lin和他的团队必须挺过一场致命的战斗才能完成任务。)

programme.title: Last Song For You ((久别·重逢))
programme.desc: That summer, young Xia and Su bonded over their love of music, wondering how far this love could take them. Years later, musician Su unexpectedly reunites with his first love, Xia, in a hospital during their darkest hours. Seeing his inner struggle, the ailing Xia sends Su on a final journeyher parting gift to reignite his life. (夏天,年轻的Xia和Su为他们的音乐爱而纠缠在一起,想知道这种爱能带他们走多远。 几年后,音乐家Su Suu突然与他的初恋Xia在最黑暗的时间内在医院里团聚。 悲哀的Xia和Su看到自己的内心斗争,最后的旅途礼物是离开苏,重现他的生活。)

programme.title: High Forces ((危机航线))
programme.desc: On its maiden flight, an A380 airliner is hijacked by armed gunmen. Among the passengers is international security expert Gao Hao Jun, whose daughter has been taken hostage, putting her life in grave danger. Determined to save her, Gao confronts the hijackers head-on. Can he rescue all the passengers and thwart the crisis? (在少女航班上,武装枪手劫持了一架A380型班机,乘客中包括国际安全专家高浩俊,她的女儿被劫持为人质,她的生命处于严重危险之中。 高高决心救她,直面劫机者。 他能够救出所有乘客并挫败危机吗?)

programme.title: Welcome to My Side ((欢迎来到我身边))
programme.desc: After a painful breakup and a strange accident, Chen Xiao Zhou is haunted by flocks of quacking rubber ducks that only he can see. His bizarre curse disappears whenever he is with the cheerful Feng Jia Nan. As they grow closer, an absurd yet heartwarming romance blossoms, changing both their lives in unexpected ways. (陈小周在痛苦的分手和奇特的事故后,被一群只有他能看见的摇摇晃晃晃的橡皮鸭缠住了。 每当他和欢乐的冯佳南在一起时,他的怪咒就会消失。 随着他们的亲近,一个荒谬而又令人心动的浪漫花花,以出乎意料的方式改变了他们的生活。)

programme.title: Way We Talk, The (我们的说法)
programme.desc: This is a soul-searching story about three youths: Wolf, Sophie and Alan, each living with a different form of deafness. Through sign language, they cultivate a profound friendship and offer each other unwavering support. United by love and friendship, the trio embarks on a journey of self-discovery and resilience. (这是关于三个青年的令人深思的故事:沃尔夫、索菲和艾伦,他们各自都生活在不同形式的聋哑中。他们通过手语培养了深厚的友谊并相互提供坚定的支持。 以爱和友谊团结在一起,三重心开始了自我发现和复原力的旅程。)

programme.title: Someday Or One Day ((想见你))
programme.desc: The movie is a spin-off from the TV series of the same name. While Huang Yu Xuan mourns the death of her boyfriend, she receives a mysterious cassette player that allows her to travel back in time. She meets her boyfriend then again, but will she be able to change his destiny? (这部电影是同一个名字的电视系列片的副产品。 当黄玉须哀悼其男友的去世时,她收到了一个神秘的磁带播放器,允许她及时返回。 她再次见到她的男朋友,但是她能改变他的命运吗?)

programme.title: Bursting Point ((爆裂点))
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Bang sends Officer Ming undercover to a drug cartel to displace drug lord Yang. A failed raid triggers Yangs rage for revenge. Meanwhile, drug maker Ying Xiu is forced to cooperate with the police and sets a trap for Yang. The battle between the police and the drug cartel has just begun! (邦督察长派明警官卧底去贩毒集团以取代毒枭杨。一次失败的突袭引发杨氏复仇的愤怒。 与此同时,制毒的尹秀被迫与警方合作,并为杨设了一个陷阱。 警方和毒贩的战斗才刚刚开始!)

programme.title: Hong Kong Family ((奸人世家))
programme.desc: Eight years ago, the family in a Hakka-walled village was torn apart during a combative winter solstice dinner. Eight years later, their cousin returns home from England and seeks to reunite the family for another winter solstice dinner. While things seem to be falling apart, this dinner may well be an opportunity to mend relations.

programme.title: YOLO ((乐活姐妹：怪诞冒险))
programme.desc: Feeling lost and aimless, Le Ying chooses to withdraw from society after a short working experience. After a series of unexpected events one day, she decides to embrace life anew. She sees a chance for a fresh start when she meets a boxing coach, yet the challenges ahead far exceed her expectations, marking a vibrant start to her journey. (黎英在短短的工作经历之后选择退出社会。 一天,在一系列意外事件之后,她决定重新拥抱生活。 当她遇到拳击教练时,她看到了重新开始的机会,但前面的挑战远远超过她的期望,标志着她的旅程充满活力的开始。)

programme.title: Schemes in Antiques ((古董局中局))
programme.desc: Despite his familys expertise in ancient Chinese relics, Xu Yuan becomes an electronics shop owner to distance himself from his disgraced family. However, when an antique is to be returned to China, Xu Yuan uncovers an ancient mystery and soon embarks on a journey that can finally restore his familys reputation but may also cost him his life. (尽管徐元家族在古代中国遗迹中拥有丰富的经验,但徐元还是电子商场的业主,以便与他丢脸的家族保持距离。 然而,当古董被送回中国时,徐元发现了一个古老的谜题,并很快踏上一条旅程,最终可以恢复其家族的名誉,但也可能让他丧失生命。)

programme.title: Mamas Affair ((巨星养成记))
programme.desc: Former talent manager Mei Fung stays home to take care of her husband and son after retirement. She decides to re-enter the entertainment business to find her value in life, and successfully transforms a local restaurant delivery boy, Fong Ching, into a young pop idol. This makes her teenage son, Jonathan, intensely jealous of Fong Ching. (前任人才经理Mei Fung退休后留在家里照顾丈夫和儿子。 她决定重新进入娱乐行业以寻找她的生活价值,并成功地将当地一家餐厅的送餐男孩Fong Ching变成一个年轻的偶像。 这让她十几岁的儿子Jonathan非常嫉妒Fong Ching。)

programme.title: Triad ((三生花))
programme.desc: This is a story about the Hong Kong Triads. Ting William Chan. Cheung Derek Tsang and Dong Edward Chui are childhood friends who join a Triad together. After joining however, they discover that fame and fortune will ultimately break them apart as only one of them can become the leader of the gang. (这是关于香港三合会的故事。 钟·威廉·陈。 张德里克·赞和东·爱德华·楚伊是童年的朋友,他们一起加入三合会。 但是,在加入后,他们发现名声和财富最终将粉碎他们,因为他们中只有一人能够成为黑帮头目。)

programme.title: Back to the Past ((寻秦记))
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lives in seclusion for 20 years. However, peace is shattered when a group of time travellers returns with modern weapons to seize the Qin throne. Forced to reunite after decades apart, Hong Siu Lung and Ying Zheng must fight to defend the Qin dynasty and protect the fate of history itself. (帮助英正团结中国后,洪小龙在隔离中生活了20年,然而,当一群时空旅行者带着现代武器返回时,夺回秦王位,和平就破灭了。 数十年后被迫重聚,洪小龙和英正必须奋力捍卫秦王,保护历史的命运。)

programme.title: Reunion Dinner (聚会晚餐)
programme.desc: Chao Yang and Zi Hong are soon to wed but both have not met the others parents. When a client requests for a livestream of their reunion dinner to promote his products, it set the stage for their parents first meeting. Estranged from his mother, Yang decides to rent a family for the dinner which results in a series of mishaps and hilarity. (Chao Yang和Zi Hong很快就要结婚了,但双方都没有见到其他父母。 当客户请求为宣传其产品而提供一次同学会晚餐的活流时,这为他们父母的首次会面铺平了道路。 与母亲不同,杨决定为晚餐租个家庭,这导致一系列的不幸和分裂。)

programme.title: Life Must Go On ((The Show Must Go On（1991年皇后乐队演唱歌曲）))
programme.desc: When the midnight gymnasium programme for wayward teenage girls is at funding risk, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match and save it. With an ex-star athlete John as the coach, the girls realize they must face their problems and overcome their challenges instead of dodging them. Can they finally win the match? (当为流浪少女举办的午夜健身房项目面临资金风险时,社会工作者Yanki召集了一个躲避球队,以比赛为比赛并拯救比赛。 女孩们以前明星运动员John为教练,意识到她们必须面对自己的问题,克服挑战,而不是逃避挑战。 她们最终能够赢得比赛吗?)

programme.title: Atonement ((下一个就是你))
programme.desc: Single father Ah Long lives a humble life with his beloved daughter, believing kindness will always be rewarded. However, when she is abducted during a trip to Thailand, his faith shatters. Desperate to find her, he marries a local Chinese woman to remain in the country and hunt down a human trafficking ring, becoming a blood-soaked avenger.

programme.title: Scandal ((丑闻))
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next? (这场喜剧中的官员们收集了腐败的证据。 经过一连串的勒索后,他们最终成了掌权者,但接下来会发生什么呢?)

programme.title: Pursuit ((当幸福来敲门))
programme.desc: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynastys Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge. (这部电影讲述了宋朝陆军总教官林宗的故事,他被一名腐败官员陷害,不得不开始充满危险的流亡。 在一位和尚的帮助下,林宗终于能够复仇。)

programme.title: When The Clouds Roll By ((当云匆匆消散时))
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love. (苏是一个精神分裂症患者,她拒绝相信她的飞行员爱人在飞机事故中丧生,并发明故事来处理事情.她遇到了老同学莱,他也是医生,他找到了治疗她的疾病的方法.苏慢慢恢复并接受现实,以及她的新发现的爱.)

programme.title: Ode to Gallantry ((侠客行))
programme.desc: In this surprisingly light-hearted Venoms martial arts adventure, a lone wanderer is repeatedly mistaken for someone else and drawn into a number of violent battles. (在这个令人惊的轻松的武术冒险中, 一个孤独的流浪者被错误地误认为是别人,)

programme.title: Call of the Sea ((彻夜之歌))
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yus beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair... (青少年渔民,胡爱上了他的童年朋友宇.然而,一个镇上暴徒的唯一的儿子渴望宇的美丽,并试图尽可能地接近她.胡有一天保护另一个女人免受暴徒的侵害,导致宇误解他并怀疑他们有着情侣关系.)

programme.title: Legendary Weapons Of China ((十八般武艺))
programme.desc: Lei Kung, the leader of the Boxer Clan in Yunnan, dissolves the clan to save his disciples before going into self-exile. The Clan sends various assassins to kill him but failed. They then assigned Kungs brother Yong to find and kill Kung, leading to a battle between the two brothers. (南拳击手族的领导人莱康在自流亡前解散了该族群,以拯救他的门徒.该族群派出了各种刺客来杀了他,但失败.他们随后委托斯兄弟永找到和杀死,导致两兄弟之间的战斗.)

programme.title: The Mermaid ((小美人鱼))
programme.desc: Zhang and Jins daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit. (张和的女儿皮奥尼出生时订婚,但金现在反对订婚.张遇到了一个看起来像皮奥尼的卡尔普精神,他们就恋爱了.当法官巴奥被金要求区分皮奥尼和她的副本时,他决定在见证张和卡尔普精神之间的真爱时辞去案例.)

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress ((萧十一郎))
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the Deer Sword. Lians wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiaos home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wifes faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao. (故事发生在一个武术世界里,每个人都试图获得鹿剑。 连安的妻子在伏击中受伤,他的对手小晓救了她。她们逃到小施家,他治疗她的毒伤。这导致连怀疑妻子的忠诚,导致与小晓发生几次流血决斗。)

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? ((喷火美人鱼))
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders, it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd. (肖兄弟华人-德明星Jenny Hu在"猜谁杀了我的十二个爱人"中获得了她的第一个喜剧角色.)

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman ((丹下左膳 妖刀濡れ燕))
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her. (独臂剑客方康想和妻子过平静的生活,但当她被八大恶魔剑客氏团绑架时,他被迫带着他们去救她。)

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox (狐的传说)
programme.desc: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the mens help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father. (一位年轻人(Chin)认为他是一个孤儿,直到他遇见了三个人,并向他们学习到他的父亲是一位伟大的剑客,他的父亲在试图消除关于不法行为的谣言并将丢失的剑还给其合法主人时被杀害了。 Chin寻找男人帮助报复他父亲的不法死亡。)

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing ((茅山僵尸拳))
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts! (陈先生和他学徒的范家运送僵尸来谋生,他们被雇用一去搬9个僵尸。当2个跳跃离开时,人们发现一个人实际上是一个伪装的人,试图逃离敌人。事实证明变形僵尸和陈先生都是武术专家!)

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth ((大地儿女))
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows... (这是中日战争时期的史诗故事。 一位画家于优拯救了一位年轻女孩Lotus,Lotus,她正被卖给妓院。她们坠入爱河,结婚并安顿下来过上平静的生活。然而,他们的生活很快被日本的入侵和随后的残暴政权所摧毁。)

programme.title: The Grand Substitution ((万古流芳))
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official. (在这个歌剧史诗中,一位忠于帝国法院的仆人 放弃了自己的新生儿子 来拯救王子免遭邪恶官员的伤害)

programme.title: The Wandering Swordsman ((游侠儿))
programme.desc: The wandering swordsman Yu Hsieh Erh has formidable sword skills and helps the poor by robbing from thieves and distributing the wealth. He meets a group of bandits who are planning to rob a convoy escorting some valuables and is tricked into participating in the robbery. Yu soon realizes his folly and returns to take revenge on the bandits. (横行的剑客尤希埃(Yu Xieh Erh)掌握强大的剑法,通过抢掠盗贼和分配财富来帮助穷人。 他遇到了一群土匪,他们计划抢劫护送一些贵重物品的车队,并被骗参与抢劫。 尤伊很快就意识到他的愚蠢并返回来报复匪徒。)

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler ((玉女嬉春))
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping Irene Chen I-ling and Pai-hung Betty Ting Pei and ends when they are cast in a new movie. (导演伊诺伊·乌梅茨古在"黄"中迎接了夜总表演者的光世界.该电影描绘了两位歌唱妹妹,清平爱琳·陈·灵和挂贝蒂·廷·佩的斗争,并在新电影中被演出时结束.)

programme.title: Brothers Five ((兄弟 Five))
programme.desc: The five Kao brothers, separated since birth, are unaware that the master of Teng Lung Manor has killed their father. All five however, vow to defeat the vicious gangsters at the manor due to their bullying ways. After reuniting and with much discipline and hard work, the Kaos are prepared to face Lung and his gang. (5个自出生以来分离的考兄弟不知道邓龙庄主杀死了他们的父亲。 然而,所有5个兄弟都因为欺凌而发誓打败庄园里的恶棍。 在重新团结、纪律严明和辛勤工作之后,高山准备面对龙及其帮派。)

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu ((疯猴))
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chens past insult. (陈先生是一位受尊敬的子功夫大师,直到他被一个无情的恶棍入了架子和了,最终成为一个流浪艺术家.当陈在街上遇到一个年轻人,小子,他决定教他他的子功夫运动.)

programme.title: Perils Of The Sentimental Swordsman ((楚留香之幽灵山庄))
programme.desc: Chu Liuxiang and the Eighth Prince stage a fake assassination attempt, allowing Chu to infiltrate Ghostly Manor as an undercover agent and eradicate this den of evil. The manor harbours notorious martial arts criminals and is rumoured to be haunted. Soon, during his investigation, Chu becomes entangled in a series of mysterious and eerie events. (楚留香和八世王子的阴谋是假暗杀,让楚作为卧底潜入幽灵庄园,铲除这个邪恶的巢穴。 庄园窝藏了臭名昭著的武术罪犯,并被传闻为闹鬼。 不久,在调查期间,朱楚就卷入了一系列神秘而神秘的事件。)

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee ((新陈三五娘))
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide. (黄梅歌剧情中的奇怪标题是指两个道具,表明学者和当地美女之间有一个幸福的开始.学者抛光镜子,以接近他的爱情,谁通过扔一些子来表示她的认可.从那时起,他们的爱情变得摇滚,满满谋杀和自杀.)

programme.title: Saithan
programme.desc: Dinesh, a senior software engineer, lives a happy life until he returns from his honeymoon only to become mentally disturbed. Things get worse when the voice inside his head tells him to die.

programme.title: Thangaraja
programme.desc: Engal Thanga Raja is about a brother who seeks revenge for the murder of his brother by pretending to be an escaped convict.

programme.title: Veetla Visesham
programme.desc: Elango, a 26-year-old man, is shocked to discover that his mother is pregnant. His struggle to come to terms with the news puts his relationship with his girlfriend, Sowmya, in jeopardy.

programme.title: Mark Antony
programme.desc: Mark, the son of a former gangster, comes across a mobile phone that can time-travel. Using the phone, Mark acquires the ability to save his estranged mother from a grim fate.

programme.title: Kurup
programme.desc: Driven by greed, Kurup weaves lies, fake deaths, and identity theft. His scheme takes a twist when a clever policeman starts pursuing him.

programme.title: Free Ticket

programme.title: Pitch Black ((星际传奇))
programme.desc: In Pitch Black, Vin Diesel stars as Riddick, a dangerous convict stranded on a desert planet with survivors. Facing carnivorous monsters and scorching suns, they must trust each other to survive the deadly night. (在"黑色"中,Vin Diesel扮演了Riddick,一个危险的囚犯,被困在沙漠星球上,与幸存者.)

programme.title: The Chinese Widow (中国寡妇)
programme.desc: In 1941, after bombing Tokyo, a US pilot makes an emergency landing in China. A local widow rescues him and risks everything to hide him from Japanese forces. (1941年,在东京轰炸后,一名美国飞行员紧急登陆中国.)

programme.title: The Assassination Bureau ((国际暗杀局))
programme.desc: An Edwardian journalist uncovers a secret society that assassinates for money. To dismantle it, she hires the bureau to kill its own charismatic chairman, triggering a deadly game of cat-and-mouse across Europe.

programme.title: A Hazard Of Hearts ((心灵的冒险))
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler risks and loses his daughter Serenas hand in marriage and her entire inheritance in a high-stakes wager. She is sent to live in a dark, mysterious mansion run by a cold lady, navigating betrayal and unexpected romance.

programme.title: A Bees Diary ((蜜蜂日记))
programme.desc: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bees Diary tells that story. (蜂巢里,有成千上万的小动物致力于实现一个共同的目标:殖民地生存.)

programme.title: Great Parks Of Africa ((了不起的非洲公园))
programme.desc: In a park where land meets sea, the natural elements combine to create wonderful variety. Cola-colored water feeds forests green and dense. Fire and wind fuel growth in great diversity and rock shapes a coastline of many faces. Life thrives here - from the magnificent to the bizarre. This is the Garden Route National Park. (在一个陆地与海洋交汇的公园里,自然元素结合了各种自然元素,创造了各种奇妙的品种。可兰花颜色的海水为绿色和稠密的森林提供原料。火和风能以巨大的多样性和岩石的生长为燃料,形成了多面的海岸线。这里的生活蓬勃发展,从壮丽的到奇异的。这就是花园之路国家公园。)

programme.title: Great Parks Of Africa ((了不起的非洲公园))
programme.desc: In the northern reaches of the Kruger National Park, life depends on one thing - water. In a land burdened by heat and drought a single ribbon cuts its reliable course through the wilderness. Its a lifeline to all creatures, great and small. (在克鲁格国家公园的北端,生命取决于一件事——水。 在受炎热和干旱重压的土地上,单条丝带在荒野中切开其可靠路线。它是所有生物的生命线,不分大小。)

programme.title: Great Parks Of Africa ((了不起的非洲公园))
programme.desc: Augrabies is where the mighty Orange River plunges over the awesome 56 meter Augrabies waterfall. Derived from a word oukurubes which means place of thunder in the indigenous language of the Nama-Khoi this land is the heart of a harsh and sun-beaten world with flashes of brilliant color and a thunderous roar. (强大的奥兰治河(Augrabies)在56米高的奥兰比河瀑布上喷洒了巨大的56米高的瀑布。 从一个词“oukurubes ” ( oukulubes ) 衍生出在纳马科伊土著语中的雷鸣之地,这片土地是一个严酷和阳光严酷的世界的中心,其闪耀的颜色闪耀和雷鸣。)

programme.title: Great Parks Of Africa ((了不起的非洲公园))
programme.desc: Food, water and shelter are essential to all life on earth from the smallest of beings to the largest, and along the banks of one of Africas greatest rivers, some animals struggle while others thrive. A rhythm drives all animals as they journey in search of what they need to survive, and each must decide where and when to move if theyre to succeed... These are the magical worlds of the Lower Zambezi.

programme.title: Great Parks Of Africa ((了不起的非洲公园))
programme.desc: In the heart of Zululand, South Africa, lies the oldest game reserve on the African continent - Hluhluwe-iMfolozi. Here, Southern white rhinos have found protection from people in times of turmoil. Hunted almost to extinction at the end of the 19th century, the parks establishment gave rhinos a lifeline - breeding them back from extinction.

programme.title: Wild Science (野科学)
programme.desc: Trace the lions rise from prehistoric predator to modern ruler as science reveals the battles, bonds, and brutal survival strategies that have shaped this iconic African hunter. Get swept up in the drama of lion society and high-risk hunts. (追寻狮子从史前掠食者上升到现代统治者,因为科学揭示了塑造了这个具有象征意义的非洲猎人的战斗、纽带和残酷的生存策略。 被狮子社会和高风险狩猎的剧情扫荡一空。)

programme.title: Wild Science (野科学)
programme.desc: Confront the oceans most versatile and formidable predator. Learn about the biological advantages that helped this prehistoric species survive multiple mass extinctions, then get awed by the relentless hunting skills of bull sharks. (了解这些生物的优势 帮助这些史前物种生存下来 经历了多次大规模灭绝 并被公牛鲨鱼无情的捕猎技巧所迷惑)

programme.title: Wild Science (野科学)
programme.desc: Revisit the evolutionary journey of brown bears, from ursid ancestors that dominated the ice ages to todays modern omnivores. Witness their symbiotic relationship with salmon and the surprisingly interconnected ecosystems they thrive in. (重新审视褐熊的进化历程,从主宰冰河时代的乌希德祖先到现代食肉动物。 见证它们与鲑鱼的共生关系以及它们生长的令人惊讶的相互关联的生态系统。)

programme.title: Wild Science (野科学)
programme.desc: Follow the journey of the black rhino and see how adaptation and conservation have influenced the evolution of an ancient titan of nature. Experience this armoured herbivores extraordinary hearing, sense of smell, and other biological advantages.

programme.title: Guardians of the Wild ((野生动物守护者))
programme.desc: Across Africa 97 of black rhinos have been killed for their horns. In 1997 the species was declared officially extinct in Zambia. But now, thanks to an ambitious reintroduction plan, theyre back. Poaching hasnt gone away - their horns are still prized in Asian medicine. But a small, dedicated team are fighting to keep them safe. This is the frontline of conservation - it doesnt get any tougher.

programme.title: Guardians Of The Wild ((野生动物守护者))
programme.desc: Its a critical time for two black rhinos in Zambia. Four year old female Apson and fourteen year old bull Kango are at the core of a complex relocation mission thats part of a grand plan to save a species.

programme.desc: Deep in Kafue National Park, the largest and wildest protected area in Zambia, a team of biologists and vets from the Zambian Carnivore Programme ZCP races against time to save and protect Africas apex predators.

programme.desc: Join the rescue team for a madcap chase after a red-tailed hawk. He may be unable to fly, but he sure can run! Then follow the recovery of a rare albino squirrel who cant walk, and see how the medical team ensures hell be ready for the wild again.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends ((Amazing Animal 老友记))
programme.desc: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends, including ranch manager Barclay, a Great Dane who happens to be a gifted horse whisperer. In Africa, a tiny marmoset called Thor has become obsessed with two young rescued mongooses.

programme.title: Land Of Primates ((驯荒记))
programme.desc: The gelada is a rare monkey that lives in the Simien Mountains of Ethiopia. Theyre charismatic, vocal, and mix affection and confrontation. Watch as they face the challenges of their habitatand each other.

programme.title: Land Of Primates ((驯荒记))
programme.desc: Enter the wilds of South Africa to get an intimate look into one of the continents most misunderstood primates. Like humans, these primates have unique personalities and share strong bonds with their families and friends.

programme.title: Land Of Primates ((驯荒记))
programme.desc: As humans take up more space, the baboons of Africa must adapt. Travel across the continent to watch them form unbreakable social bonds, serve to protect their families and survive a changing landscape.

programme.title: Land Of Primates ((驯荒记))
programme.desc: Off the coast of Tanzania, baby Kima lives with his family of red Colobus monkeys. But what happens when he loses his way? Discover how this little monkey learns to adapt to life in the jungleand find out if he can reconnect with his family again.

programme.title: Colombias Wild Coast
programme.desc: Gorgona was once home to Colombias Alcatraz. Modelled on Nazi concentration camps, prisoners dreamt of escape. See the islands stunning wildlife through the eyes of a convict on the run, the monkeys, snakes and sloths whove now reclaimed the land.

programme.title: Colombias Wild Coast
programme.desc: On the island of Providencia, a black crab begins the mission of her life, escorting 80,000 eggs from her home, on a 3 km hike to the coast. Join her, and millions of her clan, on a journey fraught with danger, where chances of survival are slim.

programme.title: Wildlife ER ((Wild终生惩戒 ER))
programme.desc: Deal with duelling duckling roundups and find out if vet Karina calls in specialists to treat koala Spikes leg fracture. Get to the bottom of stomach issues plaguing baby echidnas Ping and Pong, and meet koala Jarrah, who seems to have lost his way. (了解兽医卡里娜是否调用专家来治疗鱼脚骨折,了解鱼和鱼的胃部问题,)

programme.title: Wildlife ER ((Wild终生惩戒 ER))
programme.desc: Contend with a flood of abandoned koala joeys, then join vet nurse Nick on a hunt for natural remedies to treat a wallabys gut ailment. Ponder options for a baby bat stuck in a tree and look on as vet Karina operates on a barn owls fractured wing. (面对大量废弃的牛排,然后和兽医护士尼克一起寻找自然疗法治疗瓦拉比的肠道病。 潘德选择了被困在树上的婴儿蝙蝠,然后看着兽医卡丽娜在谷仓猫翼上操作。)

programme.title: The Living Beach ((生动海滩))
programme.desc: Florida is famous for its sandy shoresand theres plenty to go around. Florida has the most tidal shoreline of any state in the continental USA. These ocean-side playgrounds are also critical habitats for threatened and endangered species. (佛罗里达以沙滩海岸闻名,有很多地方可以绕行。 佛罗里达州是美国大陆任何州最潮汐的海岸线。 这些海洋边游乐场也是濒危物种的重要栖息地。)

programme.title: The Living Beach ((生动海滩))
programme.desc: At either edge of the province, Nova Scotia proves that any beach is built from raw forces in opposition, but also that balance between those forces is necessary if life is to thrive. (诺瓦斯科蒂亚证明,任何海都是由反对势力构建的,)

programme.title: The Living Beach ((生动海滩))
programme.desc: The Yucatn Peninsula is home to tourists, sea turtles, and sargassum seaweed. How do the three coexist in harmony? Is it sustainable? Uncover the secrets behind this Mexican beach, including an ancient birthing ritual that takes place each year.

programme.title: The Great Elephant Tale ((The Great 大象 Tale))
programme.desc: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

programme.title: Tusker: Brotherhood of Elephants ((Tusker: 龙争虎斗 of Elephants))
programme.desc: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the worlds largest land mammal. (让你与所有阶段的非洲大象,克雷格,帕斯卡尔和以扫一起深入了解鱼的复杂生活.)

programme.title: Africas Wild Year ((非洲狂野之年))
programme.desc: In Southern Africa, Spring starts in early September and the natural world stirs into life. Days begin to lengthen, temperatures rise, and animals and plants combine in an orchestrated effort to reproduce, give birth and raise their young.

programme.title: Africas Wild Year ((非洲狂野之年))
programme.desc: Summer in Africa is a season of extremes, it separates the weak from the strong. It tests the survival instincts of cheetahs, lions, geckos, turtles and many more species as they search for food and water in the extreme heat of summer.

programme.title: Africas Wild Year ((非洲狂野之年))
programme.desc: Autumn in Africa brings opportunities. Cape Fur seals, Samango monkeys, chameleons, impala, and more respond to the season. Autumn triggers changes in the lives of many animals. Rare creatures reveal themselves and predators gather to take advantage.

programme.title: Africas Wild Year ((非洲狂野之年))
programme.desc: Be an eyewitness to the death and resurrection that winter brings to Africa. Observe what comes with shorter days, from drought conditions to frigid winds, and marvel at the survival skills of animals and plants as they face the seasons fury.

programme.title: How The Wild Things Sleep ((中文名))
programme.desc: Tap into one of the least understood areas of animal science: sleep. Check out adaptations made by the most extreme snoozers on Earth, from tiny bees who doze for 20 hours a day to enormous elephants who survive on just two precious hours of rest. (动物科学最不知名的领域之一是睡眠. 了解地球上最极端的雪者所做的适应,从每天20小时睡觉的小蜜蜂到只需两小时休息才能生存的巨大的大象.)

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 五年規劃及施政報告落實北都住大啲，將45平方或以上單位的比例由百分之二十增加至百分之二十五，房屋局局長何永賢接受大鳴大放專訪時表示，注重房屋階梯上進上流，未來十年的公屋資助房屋私樓的供應比例433為基礎，建立平衡健康的置業階梯不過，外界一直建議要提升人均居住面積在這次規劃未見落墨房屋局局長何永賢指局方不以人均面積計算，而是以甲乙丙丁的戶型，她指到203132年度所有單位面積預計可增加百分之十，並有信心到2027年公屋輪候時間下降至4.5年，五年規劃列出指標，在2030年公屋輪候時間達4年以下何永賢表示注重房屋階梯上進上流，出租公屋是第一個讓基層市民有個安居之所將來有能力置業的居民交出公屋給有需要的人，房屋局興建多些居屋：我們有一個叫433的比例，出租公屋4成資助出售房屋3成私樓3成，一個平衡健康的置業階梯，還要有個流動性，一步步推進公屋輪候時間下降她又指興建大量房屋亦要提速提量，包括引進了組裝合成建築法MiC三寶現時有10條公共屋邨引用科技，智慧屋邨管理，何永賢指按公共屋邨的不同特性試行各種不同的智慧模式管理至於今年3月起按先登記後執法原則分階段推展的簡樸房制度，目前寬限期登記申請反應理想何永賢表示目前簡樸房登記已收到72880宗，佔整體11萬個分間單位的三分之二，她說比預期理想，有信心達到五年規劃列明2030年基本淘汰劣質劏房對於近期熱議有居屋單位一劏五謀取租金暴利的做法有違公營房屋原意，何永賢指若業主補足了地價是有自由在公開市場出售出租，不過，她強調該居屋一劏五是申請登記，但能否獲得認證，局方要檢視圖則，大厦公契等

programme.title: 經緯線
programme.desc: 由一個普通人，搖身一變，成為自己喜歡的動漫角色，Cosplay角色扮演，令不少人夢想成真今年八月，有化妝師與流行鼓老師組隊，代表香港出戰於日本名古屋舉行的世界Cosplay峰會，憑演繹電玩遊戲魔物獵人奪得冠軍，成為該賽事二十三年來首支奪冠的香港隊伍為了準備兩分半鐘的舞台表演，二人花了一年時間，重複修改服飾與道具，甚至由零開始自學動畫製作技術；他們希望藉著世界冠軍的榮譽，讓公眾明白Cosplay背後所需的熱誠與匠人精神，打破社會對這項活動的既有刻板印象除了競賽，亦有人將熱情轉化為事業有動漫愛好者，由自學製作道具，到遠赴台灣向電影道具師傅拜師求教，最後決定辭去閉路電視維修員的工作，全職經營Cosplay工作室他透過開班授徒，指導學員運用不同物料雕琢裝備，將興趣職業化，同時陪伴更多同好實現心中的英雄夢Cosplay亦不再是年輕人的專屬領域有社區中心舉辦樂齡Cosplay活動，吸引十八位年齡介乎四十二至七十九歲的銀髮族參與其中一位退休女士，換上神奇女俠服飾走入動漫電玩節，打破過往在寫字樓工作時文靜優雅的形象；這種身份轉換的嘗試，讓銀髮族在面對退休的心理關口時，能透過代入角色，重新尋找自我價值與面對改變的勇氣，同時亦促使不同世代之間產生理解與共鳴有專研動漫文化的學者指出，大眾往往能在眾多動漫角色中，尋找與自身產生共鳴的理想自我角色扮演者不僅是單純欣賞角色的外表，更認同並渴求學習該角色所具備的毅力或正義感等內在特質；透過親身演繹與模仿，除了能獲得同好的支持與社會迴響，滿足心理上的成就感外，亦能藉此將正向的世界觀投射到現實生活中

programme.title: 금수미앙
programme.desc: 군웅이 할거하고 전쟁이 끊이지 않던 남북조 시대, 북위와의 전쟁에 패한 북량의 황제는 나라를 구하기 위해 북위에 볼모로 끌려간다. 북량의 공주 심아는 천진난만하고 근심 걱정 없는 명랑한 소녀로 주변 사람들의 사랑을 받으며 남부럽지 않은 유년시절을 보내고... 아버지가 북위에서 돌아온 날, 북량은 북위 태부 집안의 계략에 의해 하룻밤 새 멸망한다. 북위의 공격에 도망치던 심아는 우연히 이미앙을 만나 도움을 받지만 이미앙은 죽임을 당하고... 자신의 인생을 모두 앗아가버린 원수와 그 일족을 무너뜨리기 위해 심아는 이미앙의 신분을 빌려 북위를 향한 복수를 시작하는데...

programme.desc: lt국두gt와 lt홍등gt으로 유명한 장예모 감독의 작품이다. lt집으로 가는 길gt은 최첨단 과학이 발달하고 정서가 메말라 가는 요즘 세대가 보면 답답하게 느껴질 정도로 고리타분한 정서로 사랑을 이야기하는 작품이다. 아무리 작은 것이라도 사랑하는 사람에게서 받는다면 그것은 이 세상에서 단 하나밖에 없는 물건이 된다는 작은 진리를 느끼게 해주고, 또한 개방적인 연애가 판을 치는 요즘, 보수적인 마을에서의 숨바꼭질 같은 사랑 또한 신선함을 넘어선 신기함으로 비춰진다. 무엇보다 자연을 그대로 그려놓은 듯한 아름다운 화면이 인상적이다. 영화는 흑백의 99년과 천연색 58년을 오가며 늙은 쟈오 디가 어째서 추운 겨울 직접 관을 지고 먼 길을 걷고자 하는지 일러준다. lt와호장룡gt으로 일약 스타 반열에 접어든 장쯔이의 데뷔작이기도 하다.

programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.
